operations.name: search_flights
operations.description: Search Singapore Airlines for fare prices on a given route and date. Returns a 15-day fare window centred on the requested date.

args.name: origin
args.description: Departure IATA airport code (e.g. SIN, LHR, JFK)

args.name: destination
args.description: Arrival IATA airport code (e.g. LHR, SIN, SYD)

args.name: date
args.description: Target departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format

args.name: cabin_class
args.description: Cabin class: ECONOMY, PREMIUM ECONOMY, BUSINESS, or FIRST
